subject.title: Add option to hide session status card

question: Should OpenClaw add a core status-card visibility setting for chat `/status` and `session_status`, and should it hide the whole card or only sensitive sections such as usage and cost?
rationale: The implementation path is clear, but the permanent output shape and new config surface affect privacy, agent UX, docs, and schema compatibility, so automation should not choose the product contract on its own.

options.title: Add documented visibility control
options.body: Preserve current output by default and add a documented setting or section policy for suppressing status-card text where operators need it.

options.title: Limit to sensitive sections
options.body: Only suppress usage/cost or billing-like fields if maintainers want a narrower privacy fix without a broad status-card mode.

options.title: Reject new config surface
options.body: Keep status cards always visible if maintainers decide the extra configuration surface is not worth the complexity.

recommendation.title: Add documented visibility control
recommendation.body: Preserve current output by default and add a documented setting or section policy for suppressing status-card text where operators need it.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the original `session_status` surface and already framed this issue as the canonical product tracker in the discussion.
